contract: Whether the vendor's own branding is shown must be resolved from the entity that owns the event being messaged about — the event type's team (with its parent organization overriding) or the event owner's user+organization profile — via the single canonical resolver in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts, and every surface that renders or sends on behalf of that event (booking page, confirmation page, emails, SMS/WhatsApp, workflow automations) must derive the flag from that same resolution, never from a raw per-user column or from the automation's own owner.

defect_location.summary: Two independent wrong reads. (1) The scheduled-automation path resolves branding from the WORKFLOW's owner rather than the booked event: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 calls getHideBranding({userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId}), and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 does the same from form.userId/form.teamId, so a personal workflow attached to a team/org event resolves against the user row. (2) Every booking-side caller that feeds scheduleWorkflowReminders passes the raw per-user column instead of the resolver: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618,2793,2808 (`!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding`), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459,472 (selects only owner.hideBranding at :311 and :361), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:31,112, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:561, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671 (and a hardcoded hideBranding: true at :604), packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188. For a team event eventType.owner is null, so the flag collapses to false and the vendor footer is emitted. The booking-facing surfaces do it correctly — apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58 call shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent/shouldHideBrandingForEvent from packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:85-181, which honours team.hideBranding and team.parent/organization overrides (resolveHideBranding at :35-45) — which is exactly the disagreement the report describes. Fixing it means routing every scheduling call site through the resolver and widening the Prisma selects that currently fetch only owner.hideBranding (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:111, packages/features/bookings/lib/getBookingToDelete.ts:57, packages/features/bookings/lib/payment/getBooking.ts:40, packages/features/bookings/repositories/BookingRepository.ts:452, packages/prisma/selects/payment.ts:55-65, packages/prisma/selects/event-types.ts:122, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:170,201) so team/parent branding is available, plus the flag's pass-through types in packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56,97,213,262 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,115,147.
